blocks.t: The DIP switch on the R.B.I. Baseball Sub Board must be set as follows for the game to function properly: 1 2 3 4

Set the DIP switch on the VS. or UniSystem Main Board to select the options you want. Switches 1 and 2 are used to select the value of the coin slot. Switches 3 and 4 are used to set the amount of time or innings per credit (the game software looks at whichever comes first—time expired or innings completed). Game Option Settings MDS P.C. Board
